concept: AUFSCHLAG – fiktive Website für einen Tennis- und Badmintonverein

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: wide homepage hero for a premium but approachable German local sports club website
Primary request: dynamic badminton doubles rally in a modern municipal sports hall, four adult recreational club players of mixed genders and varied ages, one player in the foreground jumping for an overhead smash while teammates and opponents react naturally
Scene/backdrop: clean indoor badminton hall with pale timber floor, dark blue court markings, simple architecture and soft spectator blur, unmistakable badminton net and shuttlecock
Style/medium: high-end editorial sports photography, natural anatomy, credible movement, real skin and fabric texture
Composition/framing: cinematic landscape 3:2, low sideline angle, foreground action on the right third, generous calm negative space on the left for website copy, full rackets visible
Lighting/mood: bright diffused daylight mixed with warm hall lighting, energetic, welcoming, community-focused
Color palette: cobalt blue, warm off-white, restrained electric lime accents in sportswear
Constraints: adults only, realistic German community sports setting, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no professional tournament branding
Avoid: distorted hands or rackets, duplicated limbs, floating shuttlecock, extreme stadium spectacle, stock-photo posing

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: editorial feature image for tennis section of a German local sports club website
Primary request: two adult recreational tennis club members playing an energetic but friendly rally on a well-kept red clay court
Scene/backdrop: leafy local tennis grounds in Germany with modest clubhouse and simple benches softly out of focus
Style/medium: high-end candid editorial sports photography, natural body proportions, realistic clay dust and fabric
Composition/framing: landscape 4:3, viewed diagonally along the net, both players visible in action, racket and ball clearly readable, room for responsive crop
Lighting/mood: warm early evening sunlight, fresh, active and sociable
Color palette: red clay, deep green foliage, cobalt blue and off-white sportswear, tiny lime accent
Constraints: adults only, authentic amateur club atmosphere, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no major-brand marks
Avoid: professional stadium, staged handshake, distorted limbs, impossible racket strings, audience spectacle

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: community feature image for a welcoming German tennis and badminton club website
Primary request: diverse group of eight adult local club members, mixed genders and ages from early twenties to late sixties, relaxed conversation and laughter after training, holding a few tennis and badminton rackets naturally
Scene/backdrop: terrace beside a modest contemporary clubhouse
Style/medium: high-end candid editorial sports photography
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 group scene with natural spacing and room for responsive crop
Lighting/mood: warm early evening light, welcoming and sociable
Color palette: cobalt blue, off-white and restrained lime accents
Constraints: adults only, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no sponsor branding
Avoid: matching uniforms, corporate stock-photo poses, exaggerated cheering, malformed hands or rackets
